result.topic_en: The page first builds a slowly growing function f(n) from iterated logarithms. It then asks whether all one-to-one analytic transformations of the plane can be generated from simple operations such as (u, v) → (u, v f(u)), noting that this gives transcendental one-to-one transformations.
